item.title: CareSound Radio meets NHS Tayside Charitable Foundation
item.description: CareSound Radio is well known for its dedication to supporting various well-being charities and the radio station plays a vital role in helping publicise events for local charities.

item.title: Tuesday Team Talk
item.description: Tuesday Team Talk is a sports-focused program with over 370 episodes and counting. It’s one of CareSound’s most popular shows and one of our most listened-to podcasts.

item.title: King’s Award for Voluntary Services
item.description: CareSound Radio (brand name for Hospital Radio Perth) is immensely proud to announce that we have been awarded The King’s Award for Voluntary Service — the highest honour given to volunteer groups in the UK.

item.title: Football Vs. Hunger
item.description: Leading anti-poverty charity Trussell Trust launched Football vs Hunger, a campaign aimed at encouraging football clubs and fans to play their part in ending hunger in Scotland at St Johnstone’s McDiarmid Park. You can hear all about that today after the news at 2 p.m.

item.title: Winning, Again!
item.description: We are thrilled to report that CareSound Radio presenter Georgie Williams has won another national award. At the recent Hospital Broadcasting Awards ceremony in Leicestershire, Georgie was announced as the winner of the inaugural “Innovation Across Hospital Radio” award. Her story prompted an unprecedented standing ovation from around 200 delegates attending the ceremony.

item.title: Silver with Simo
item.description: We were thrilled and delighted to receive a Silver Award in the Category "Programme with Multiple Presenters" at the recent Hospital Broadcasting Awards ceremony during the Hospital Broadcasting Association Annual Conference, held this year in Leicestershire.

item.title: Two for Tea
item.description: Roy Spiers and Roland Smyth both joined CareSound Radio as teenagers in the early 90's and 35 years on are still contributing to our service. Following the award of the King's Award for Voluntary Service two representatives of CareSound Radio were invited to the Royal Garden Party at Holyrood on Tuesday 1st of July.

item.title: Working with CILPK
item.description: CareSound Radio is proud to work in partnership with local charities to help promote their work within the community. One very valued partnership is with the Centre for Inclusive Living Perth and Kinross, also known as CILPK.
